hunks.baseline: It happened in an instant.
The murky energy, visibly smaller than before, gathered at the tip of the sword and stabbed toward my heart.
hunks.sol: It happened in an instant. Murky energy—much smaller than before—gathered at its tip and thrust toward my heart.

hunks.baseline: And just before it reached me, I recited another command in my mind.
hunks.sol: A fraction of an instant earlier, I’d spoken another command in my mind.

hunks.baseline: The mass of energy, packed with terrifying destructive and cutting power, was blocked.
hunks.sol: The concentrated energy, with all its destructive force and cutting power, struck an obstacle.

hunks.baseline: In Go Jun’s eyes, which had widened once more, the armor with a faint red glow was reflected.
hunks.sol: Go Jun’s eyes widened again. Reflected in them was armor with a faint red glow.

hunks.baseline: “What, what is this……?”
hunks.sol: “Wh-what is that…?”

hunks.baseline: “What do you think it is, idiot? Life insurance.”
hunks.sol: “What do you think, idiot? Life insurance.”

hunks.baseline: The reason I had kept the Fire Dragon Armor hidden all the way to the top floor—even after taking a minor wound to the chest—was to save it for an unexpected moment like this.
hunks.sol: I’d kept Fire Dragon Armor hidden all the way to the top floor, even after taking that shallow cut across my chest, for a moment just like this.

hunks.baseline: And my prediction had been exactly right.
hunks.sol: And I’d been right.

hunks.baseline: “You…… What the hell are you……?”
hunks.sol: “You… What the hell are you…?”

hunks.baseline: I looked into the fear in his eyes.
hunks.sol: I looked into his frightened eyes.

hunks.baseline: Into the eyes of a human—or rather, a monster—driven to the edge.
hunks.sol: The eyes of a human—no, a monster—driven to the edge.

hunks.baseline: Then I put strength into the spear embedded in Go Jun’s chest.
hunks.sol: Then I drove the spear deeper into Go Jun’s chest.
